steps.title: Create a Box User app
steps.detail: Log into the Developer Console, select New App, choose User as the app type, and select Create.

steps.title: Get the redirect URI from Composio

traps.title: Developer justifies scopes

traps.title: Managed app shares quota
traps.detail: Composio's managed app shares quota across all Composio users.
